# Show what is interrupted and what the options are

Report the current state of the run.

1. Which units are in progress, how long they have been idle, and what each produced
   before stopping
2. What is complete and approved
3. Corpus totals

Then stop. Do not recommend what to work on next — the operator decides that.

If anything is interrupted, say plainly that nothing was lost: unit work is
transactional, so an interrupted unit committed nothing and restarting it re-runs it
from the beginning. That removes the impulse to go hunting for partial output that
does not exist.
